It excludes material explicitly identified on the site as third-party copyright.
accessAndRights.thirdPartyObservation: The resource page lists GSI as producer. The source property src_agency has the literal value "Survey of India (SOI)" on all 733 features; this identifies a source agency but does not itself identify a copyright holder or explicitly mark the material as third-party copyright. Reassess if a specific third-party copyright notice is later found; no rights-ownership conclusion is made here.

formatAndGeometry.horizontalCrs: EPSG:7755 (WGS 84 / India NSF LCC; literal source member urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::7755)
formatAndGeometry.coordinateOrder: Two-ordinate coordinate arrays; EPSG:7755 axis order is easting (X), northing (Y). No coordinate transformation or CRS inference from coordinate ranges was performed.
formatAndGeometry.verticalCoordinates: None observed; all positions are 2D. Vertical reference and unit are null.
formatAndGeometry.formatCompatibility: The bytes are labelled GeoJSON and contain an explicit legacy crs member. RFC 7946 omits alternate CRS members; consumers must honor EPSG:7755 or explicitly reject this source rather than assume longitude/latitude.

attributesAndCoverage.featureId: No top-level GeoJSON Feature.id values. properties.id and properties.objectid are each present and unique on 733 features; dtcode has 732 distinct values; stable-key semantics are not documented, so these are not promoted to canonical or ULPIN identities.

limitations: Original ZIP and expanded GeoJSON remain private outside Git; the repository pack includes inspection metadata only.

The NWIC page names GSI as producer; source property src_agency names Survey of India. Neither field alone establishes copyright ownership. The NWIC third-party copyright exception remains a real condition if explicit third-party marking is later found.
GeoJSON source has an explicit EPSG:7755 CRS member; no conversion was made. Treat it as projected easting/northing in metres, not RFC 7946 longitude/latitude.
The advertised and observed feature counts match; no external controls, boundary legal status, date validity or positional/topology accuracy were checked.
No 3D, building, parcel, ownership, training, runtime or scale qualification follows from this profile.
The source exposes shape_area and shape_length attributes, but their measurement units/definitions are not documented in the inspected bytes; values were not interpreted.
